ambulance noun

modern

Traupman 215, 271
M-O s.v. ambulance: arcera (automata)

arcera, arcerae f.

noun, first declension

Classically a covered wagon for the sick (Varr.; Gell.).

Examples

  • Audīn' arceram? Viā cēdāmus.

    Can you hear the ambulance? Let’s get out of the way.composed

Other words

  • arcera automatāria

    also used · modern · Vatican lexicon

  • autoarcera

    also used · modern · Traupman

See also fire engine, helicopter.

SourcesLewis & Short: arcera
